outcome: Audit lines carry what happened without carrying credentials.

acceptance_criteria.text: An audit line names the actor and the action.

expected_verification.assertion: an audit line contains the action

acceptance_criteria.text: A sensitive value in the payload does not appear in the line, wherever in the payload it sits.

expected_verification.assertion: a password nested inside the payload does not appear in the audit line

data_impact: Audit lines are appended to a log that is retained.
security_impact: A credential written to an audit log is a credential in every downstream that ingests the log.
